headline: Google's AI satellite sends its first response from space
summary: Google's AI chip-equipped satellite generated its first response from space, booting up its onboard Tensor Processing Units to let a Gemma 4 model complete a prompt and produce a haiku about being in space. Outlets describe it as an experimental orbital datacenter prototype putting its TPU to work.

claims.statement: Google's AI-chip-equipped satellite generated its first response from space, using onboard TPUs to run a Gemma 4 model that produced a haiku.
